name: kb_gemm_large_k
description: Matrix multiplication with large K dimension: C = A @ B where K >> M, N. The large reduction dimension (K) creates unique optimization challenges distinct from standard GEMM: higher memory traffic relative to compute, different tiling strategies, and greater sensitivity to reduction ordering and accumulation precision.

M.description: Number of rows in A and C

K.description: Reduction dimension (columns of A, rows of B) - intentionally large

N.description: Number of columns in B and C

name: kb_gemm_very_large_k
description: Extreme case: Matrix multiplication with extremely large K dimension (K > 1M). Tests handling of very long reductions where accumulation precision and numerical stability become critical.

M.description: Number of rows in A and C

N.description: Number of columns in B and C
